requirement.original: Fix deploy-travel-plans.sh to auto-detect the correct git branch instead of assuming main
requirement.clarified: Verify and fix the full clone/push flow in scripts/deploy-travel-plans.sh so that no hardcoded branch names remain, and the script handles both existing gh-pages repos and new empty repos correctly. The prior push bug (git push origin main) was already fixed; remaining issues are: (1) git commit failing on idempotent redeploy of same file, which causes set -euo pipefail to exit mid-script.
requirement.what: Audit branch detection throughout the script and fix the git commit failure on no-changes scenario
requirement.why: Script previously hardcoded 'main' branch in push command, causing deploy failures. Current code is mostly correct but has an edge case where deploying the same file twice silently fails at the commit step.

included: Branch variable usage audit throughout deploy script
Verify clone path (lines 348-381) uses BRANCH variable correctly
Verify push path (lines 537-547) uses BRANCH variable correctly
excluded: Network timeout handling for git ls-remote

success_criteria: No hardcoded 'main' or 'master' appears in any push, clone, or checkout command
Script completes without error when deploying the same file twice
Script correctly creates gh-pages branch when repo has no remote branches yet
BRANCH variable (defaulting to gh-pages) is used in all git operations
constraints: set -euo pipefail must remain -- no weakening of error handling
Local deploy (Step 6.5) must always succeed regardless of GitHub push outcome
git commit failure on 'nothing to commit' must be handled without swallowing other git errors

root_cause_analysis.symptom: Script fails when git push uses wrong branch name; secondary issue: script exits on git commit with no changes
root_cause_analysis.root_cause: Original script hardcoded 'git push -f origin $BRANCH' but BRANCH was not always set; earlier versions may have had 'git push origin main'. The idempotent redeploy issue exists because git commit exits with code 1 when there is nothing to commit, and set -euo pipefail propagates this as a script failure.
root_cause_analysis.root_cause_commit: 41e4544 - fix: remove force push from deployment scripts to preserve history (introduced BRANCH variable usage in push); d04e3eb - fix: Enhance deployment reliability with validation and shallow clones (made push non-fatal)
root_cause_analysis.why_introduced: Original script was written assuming force-push to a fixed branch; branch name was later parameterized but edge cases around commit/push were not fully handled
root_cause_analysis.why_problematic: On idempotent redeploy (same file content), git commit returns exit code 1 even though this is not an error condition. Under set -euo pipefail this terminates the script before the push step, even though local deploy already succeeded.
root_cause_analysis.timeline: Bug introduced pre-2026-02-12; push branch fixed in commit 41e4544; push made non-fatal in d04e3eb; git commit idempotency issue remains unfixed

development_approach.strategy: Fix the git commit step to be idempotent by checking for staged changes before committing. Confirm all branch references use the $BRANCH variable. No structural changes to the script flow.

specific_changes.change: Wrap git commit in a conditional to skip when nothing is staged: replace bare 'git commit -m ...' with 'if ! git diff --cached --quiet || git status --porcelain | grep -q .; then git commit -m ...; else echo "Nothing new to commit (local deploy already succeeded)"; fi'
specific_changes.rationale: Prevents set -euo pipefail from killing the script on idempotent redeploy; maintains error detection for other git failures

specific_changes.rationale: The original reported bug; must be verified as fully resolved
